hero.body: Resomix uses PYXIS-1 to help you find sonically related tracks, understand one recording in greater detail, or make an authorised catalogue searchable by sound.
hero.status: Live production beta · Reference-based discovery · Track Intelligence · Partner-scoped catalogues
hero.captionA: THREE DISTINCT WORKFLOWS · ONE SHARED ENGINE
hero.figureAriaD: Three separate workflow lanes share one PYXIS-1 core: Sonic Discovery from a reference to a ranked playlist; Track Intelligence from one recording to a readable analysis; Catalogue Intelligence from an authorised catalogue to partner-scoped results. Distinct workflows, one engine.
hero.figureAriaM: Mobile: the three workflows stacked, Sonic Discovery, Track Intelligence and Catalogue Intelligence, each from input through PYXIS-1 to its own output.
hero.title: Start with sound. Know where to go [[next.]]

products.body: Resomix does not force every user into the same dashboard. Choose the workflow that matches the decision in front of you.
products.sdBody: Start with one known track or upload a reference. PYXIS-1 compares its sonic profile with Resomix's pre-analysed index and returns the closest matches as a ranked playlist.
products.sdAria: A reference resolving into a compact ranked list.
products.tiQ: What is happening inside this recording?
products.tiBody: Examine how a recording moves through structure, rhythm, harmony, energy, timbre and spectral character. Read the analysis through clear timelines, metrics, confidence and interpretation.
products.tiAria: A compact structure and energy timeline.
products.ciQ: How can this catalogue be searched by sound?
products.ciBody: Process authorised catalogue recordings into a private, partner-scoped sonic index. Use one reference to retrieve the closest recordings from that catalogue, with Track Intelligence available separately when deeper examination is needed.
products.ciRail: Authorised catalogue → private index → ranked partner results
products.ciAria: A bounded partner index returning ranked results.
products.apiTitle: Bring sound-first similarity into your own product.
products.apiBody: Resomix exposes partner-scoped similarity through a guided API integration, with track analysis available on request. Your team keeps its interface, brand and customer journey.

profile.h2: PYXIS-1 turns audio into a sonic profile that can be read or compared.
profile.body1: PYXIS-1 preprocesses audio and extracts more than 70 measurable characteristics across rhythm, harmony, timbre, structure, spectral profile and energy. It combines those signals into a unique sonic profile for each recording.
profile.body2: That profile can support two different operations: Track Intelligence explains one recording in greater detail; similarity comparison measures its relationship to recordings that have already been processed and indexed.
profile.status: Proprietary algorithm · Audio-derived evidence · Not a generative system
profile.figureAriaD: One recording enters PYXIS-1; five representative signal bands, rhythm, harmony, timbre, structure and energy, combine into one sonic profile, which can be read through Track Intelligence or compared with an index for similarity ranking.
profile.figureAriaM: Mobile: one recording, five signal bands, one sonic profile, two possible operations.

discovery.h2: Start with one reference. Get a ranked playlist.
discovery.body1: Search for a track that is already indexed or upload your own reference. PYXIS-1 retrieves or creates the reference's sonic profile, compares it with Resomix's pre-analysed index and automatically ranks the closest matches.
discovery.body2: A searched track can use its existing profile immediately. An uploaded reference takes longer because it must first be processed. The candidate catalogue is already profiled and is not reanalysed during every search.
discovery.figureAriaD: Search a track or upload a reference; both converge into one reference; its sonic profile is retrieved or created, compared with the pre-analysed index, and the Sonic Discovery playlist returns ranked results.
discovery.figureAriaM: Mobile discovery flow from the two input options to the ranked playlist.

anatomy.h2: See how the track moves, changes and holds together.
anatomy.body1: Track Intelligence translates PYXIS-1 analysis into a readable view of one recording: its sections, tempo and harmonic information, energy journey, timbral and spectral character, mood and style signals, and the confidence behind key outputs.
anatomy.body2: The analysis gives artists and professionals evidence they can inspect. It supports listening and judgement; it does not replace them.
anatomy.figureAriaD: Illustrative Track Intelligence view: structural regions over a timeline, an energy curve with a marked peak against low, medium and high bands, a plain-language interpretation, and supporting rhythm, harmony, timbre, mood and confidence modules.
anatomy.figureAriaM: Mobile Track Intelligence view with structure, energy bands, peak, interpretation and supporting modules.

catalogue.h2: Make the catalogue searchable through sonic relationships.
catalogue.body1: Resomix processes authorised catalogue audio in advance and creates a stored sonic profile for each recording. Those profiles form a private, partner-scoped index that can return ranked matches from one approved reference.
catalogue.body2: This gives older, new and low-exposure recordings another route into discovery when the sonic relationship is strong, without replacing the partner's storefront, licensing workflow, brand or customer relationship.
catalogue.figureAriaD: Authorised audio and agreed metadata are pre-processed by PYXIS-1 into stored sonic profiles inside one heavy partner boundary, forming the partner-scoped sonic index. One reference query enters the index and five recording cells resolve into ranked partner results. Track Intelligence is a separate option for one authorised recording.
catalogue.figureAriaM: Mobile: authorised audio pre-processed into the partner boundary; a reference query returns ranked partner results, with Track Intelligence as a separate option.

api.body1: Platforms and music-technology teams can call Resomix through partner-scoped REST services for similarity by indexed track or approved upload. Track-analysis retrieval is enabled on request.
api.body2: Catalogue onboarding and access are agreed through a guided partner pilot. Resomix supplies the sonic capability behind the integration; the partner keeps its interface, brand and customer journey.
api.status: Partner-scoped REST API · Managed ingestion · No public sandbox
api.figureAriaD: A partner product uses a scoped API key to reach the Resomix service boundary, which contains only similarity and track-analysis services beside the same partner's index, and returns a response to the partner interface.
api.figureAriaM: Mobile: partner product, scoped API key, Resomix service boundary with the two services and the partner index, then the response back to the partner interface.

pathways.h2: Different people. Different questions. The same respect for sound.
pathways.body: Resomix changes the route according to what the person needs to decide, not according to a generic user type.
pathways.p1Dec: Find the next track without hours of unfocused digging.
pathways.p1Body: Start from one known recording and audition a ranked set of sonically related candidates.
pathways.p2Dec: Understand your recording and study the music around it.
pathways.p2Body: Inspect your own track through Track Intelligence, then use sonic relationships for reference, study and contrast while keeping the creative decision yours.
pathways.p3Dec: Give authorised recordings another route into discovery.
pathways.p3Body: Create a private sonic index for label, distributor, publisher or library recordings and retrieve relevant catalogue matches from one reference.
pathways.p4Dec: Add sound-first discovery without rebuilding the engine.
pathways.p4Body: Integrate partner-scoped similarity and track-analysis capabilities behind your own interface and customer journey.

trust.eyebrow: 09 // Control stays in the right place
trust.h2: The audio can be analysed without blurring who it belongs to.
trust.body: Resomix separates temporary user references from partner catalogue assets and keeps each partner's catalogue, credentials and index inside its own authorised boundary.
trust.c1Body: User reference uploads are used for private processing and deleted within 24 hours.
trust.c2Body: Partner catalogue assets and sonic indexes remain restricted to the applicable partner scope. There is no shared partner catalogue pool.
trust.c3Body: Partner content is not used to train or fine-tune Resomix systems, and Resomix does not generate derivative audio.
trust.c4Body: Partners retain their rights, branding, storefront, transaction flow and customer relationship unless a separate written agreement says otherwise.
trust.figureAriaD: Two independent data-handling lanes that never merge: a user reference is processed privately and deleted within 24 hours; an authorised partner catalogue is processed within its own scope into a private index with authorised partner output.
trust.figureAriaM: Mobile: the user lane and partner lane stacked and clearly separate.

closing.h2: Start with one track. Or put your catalogue in the pilot.
closing.publicTitle: Hear the discovery workflow for yourself.
closing.publicBody: Search for a known track or upload a reference and receive a ranked Sonic Discovery playlist.
closing.partnerTitle: Test Resomix on an authorised catalogue sample.
closing.partnerBody: Define the catalogue scope, comparison references and evaluation criteria with Resomix before deciding whether to integrate further.
